claims.assertion: Yazhi and Anéeka describe vampires as decaying human bodies animated by lower-astral tulpa or egregor entities.
claims.speaker: Yazhi and Anéeka
claims.qualifiers: They say blood supplies vitality or energy to the animated body.

claims.assertion: Yazhi says these entities feed on victims' fear and attention, which strengthen their manifestation.
claims.speaker: Yazhi

claims.assertion: Anéeka says vampiric beings occur worldwide and may remain dormant for decades before becoming active again.
claims.speaker: Anéeka
claims.qualifiers: She links renewed activity to events such as war.

review_flags: Supernatural claims are attributed to the speakers and are not independently substantiated.
coverage_gaps: regional vampire classifications, black-eyed children, and folklore-based countermeasures
